svg.title: MCP capability layer
svg.desc: SQL-generation and analysis agents request evidence through Text2SQLService. An allow-listed MCP capability layer exposes schema, bounded sample values, and validated read-only queries over an in-memory SQLite snapshot with SQL row and time limits.
